why: A removed Mantine symbol with no machine row stalls a consumer silently (rollhook, 19 minors) and the release gate fails a surface diff with no row.
what: packages/basalt-ui/migrations/areas/ui.json only. Created here (per-area file from v3-unhot-migrating-llms).
must_not_touch: CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/**, other areas' migrations files
contract: Row schema and generator: concepts/migration-release.md 3.2 and scripts/release-migrating* (read-only). Mapping source: concepts/primitives-distribution.md section 9 table and its prop table.
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/migrations/areas/tokens.json (landed by v3-tok-t5-rows) for row ids, kinds and valueShifts shape.
change: One row per section 9 row: kinds codemod (layout T rows, component= to render, size, data= to options=), map (each remaining tag), manual (useForm and @mantine/form, Rating, Tree, Stepper, ColorInput, WeekView and MonthView). valueShifts for every primitive height and radius read from src/tokens/table.ts at head. Attr row .mantine-Popover-dropdown to popover-content. Storage and urls arrays empty. Rule: none; the release gate release-migrating --check is the rule. Skill: the rows feed basalt-app/references/migrate.md (sk-8). Test: the schema and surface-diff check.
commits: Package (packages/basalt-ui/**) and non-package changes are separate commits in one PR (lefthook isolated-basalt-ui). Conventional, empty scope, no feat!: or BREAKING CHANGE, no attribution. Generated files come from make check, never by hand.
proof: release-migrating --check and the rows schema test.
acceptance: every Mantine symbol named in the section 9 table (113 in the census) has a row id, or is listed under manual with a reason
each valueShifts 'to' value equals the matching entry in src/tokens/table.ts (a test reads both)
no row references a primitive outside the 36 modules in ARCHITECTURE section 3 (the concept's 35 predates the virtual-list raise; cite 36 only)
the file validates against the schema with no unknown keys
git diff --name-only lists only owned paths
out_of_scope: Codemod implementation (tools/migrate-v3), rows for other areas, MIGRATING.md edits, consumer changes.
